mapper.select: SELECT license_key, status, status_message, days_until_expiry, last_verified_at, last_error, updated_by, updated_at, updater_ip FROM license_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO license_info (tenant_id, license_key, status, status_message, days_until_expiry, last_verified_at, last_error, updated_by, updated_at, updater_ip) VALUES (#{claims.tenantId}, #{licenseKey}, #{status}, #{statusMessage}, #{daysUntilExpiry}, #{lastVerifiedAt}, #{lastError}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updaterIp}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE license_key = VALUES(license_key), status = VALUES(status), status_message = VALUES(status_message), days_until_expiry = VALUES(days_until_expiry), last_verified_at = VALUES(last_verified_at), last_error = VALUES(last_error), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at), updater_ip = VALUES(updater_ip)
mapper.update: UPDATE license_info SET status = #{status}, status_message = #{statusMessage}, days_until_expiry = #{daysUntilExpiry}, last_verified_at = #{lastVerifiedAt}, last_error = #{lastError} WHERE tenant_id = #{claims.tenantId}
